spec_match.rationale: Executes both sides of the proposal's central claim (Array.prototype.join parity) live over the historically tricky cases: nullish elements, empty input, single element, default separator, ToString coercion.

interactive.rationale: Run button re-executes all six dual-sided cases; every cell is a live result, and a real divergence would render as DIFFERENT in rose.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises live both-sides comparison with divergence flagging; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: The six cases are the edge cases; the unsupported engine path shows per-case TypeErrors with an n/a parity column instead of fake agreement.

references.rationale: Feature index cites https://chromestatus.com/feature/5095183554314240; page links the proposal text.

conformance.rationale: Suite assertions (default separator, nullish, empty, ToString parity) mirror the table rows one-to-one.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP run: Array column computed real values, Iterator column showed genuine per-case TypeErrors, status explained the state; zero console errors; 0px overflow both classes; screenshots read.

design_system.rationale: same/DIFFERENT verdicts in emerald/rose on near-white rows (AA); table scrolls in its own wrapper.

accessibility.rationale: Real table with caption and scoped headers; status is role=status aria-live; parity is text, not colour-only.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Wide table scrolls inside .parity-wrap; page body 0px overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×2000.

guidanceConsulted.query: data table semantics scope caption screen reader
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Dual-comparison tables need native semantics with scoped headers.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Native table + caption + scope'd headers; parity column is textual.

guidanceConsulted.query: wide comparison table on narrow mobile viewport without page overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Own the horizontal scroll in a wrapper.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: .parity-wrap is overflow-x:auto; verified 0px page overflow at 360px.

summary: Verified headlessly (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): both columns execute live on Chromium 141 — Array results real, Iterator column honestly erroring per case — with clean console at both viewports. On a supporting engine the same table becomes a genuine parity audit; no open questions beyond the feature-wide flag-on run recorded on the sibling pages.
